content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near the O2 arena in London ignited a fire that destroyed a van and damaged a car and a lorry. Firefighters were summoned to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown shortly before eight p.m. on Saturday, and twenty‑five crews brought the blaze under control just over an hour later with no injuries reported. The incident followed a pre‑planned filming activity at the site close to the venue that will host concerts by Niall Horan and Texas the following week. London fire brigade posted on X, stating the fire is now under control, one vehicle was lost and most of a car and lorry suffered damage, and that there are no injury reports. They added that the fire stemmed from the controlled explosion on the set and that crews will stay on scene for the rest of the evening. The yard is also near London’s cable car link across the Thames, and a Met police spokesman said they are aware of reports of explosions heard in the area of the O2 in Greenwich.
